criteria.description: Patients with acute ischemic stroke and a large infarct core defined by ASPECTS 5 or lower or estimated ischemic-core volume at least 50 mL.
Internal carotid artery or middle cerebral artery M1 occlusion.
Medical care alone, including thrombolysis when eligible.
Randomized controlled trial reporting eligible clinical outcomes.
Does not study acute ischemic stroke.
Does not identify the protocol-defined large ischemic core.
Registry, case report, case-control study, cohort study, or other non-RCT.

notes: EA V3 projection of the accepted source Protocol. The Initial Record Set is supplied externally; MetaRigor does not execute or validate the Review search.
research_question: In patients with acute ischemic stroke and a large ischemic core, does endovascular therapy plus medical care, compared with medical care alone, improve functional and safety outcomes?
title: Endovascular therapy for acute ischemic stroke with a large ischemic core
